blocks.value: A value-returning function uses return to send a value back to whoever called it.

modifiers control visibility. public (usable outside the class), private (class-only), and static (callable via the class name, without creating an object) are the most common. returnType is the type of value returned; methodName is what you call it; the parameter list (optional, but the parentheses are always required) lets the caller pass in data.
Call it using its name with matching arguments in parentheses. The number, order, and types of the arguments must match the parameters:

sumOfTwoInt(3, 7);
int num = sumOfTwoInt(10, 5); // returns 15, stored in num
